Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly reported "Weston Park, Staffordshire, England" as the place of death based on information retrieved from ThePeerage.com. The actual text from ThePeerage.com specifies "Weston-under-Lizard, Staffordshire, England," which aligns with the Wikipedia entry. This misinterpretation led to the incorrect conclusion about the place of death, as the location "Weston Park" was inferred rather than directly stated.
